name: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd
tagline: CRAMS/CDMO pharma arm (ex-Suven) hit by a weak quarter and a very high promoter pledge -- speculative turnaround only
business_overview: Cohance Lifesciences (formerly Suven Pharmaceuticals) is the demerged CRAMS/CDMO pharma arm of Suven Life Sciences, offering contract research and manufacturing services.
fundamentals_table: Loss of Rs 24.1 Cr, revenue down 23.1%
fundamentals_narrative: A very wide 52-week range (high nearly 5x the low) reflects genuine volatility and uncertainty. The headline red flag is a 94.6% promoter pledge -- an extremely high figure suggesting real financial stress at the promoter level -- combined with a weak, loss-making Q1 and a sharp revenue decline. This clears the bar for HIGH CAUTION treatment.
